impact: Plan execution stalls with no LLM output and all pending tasks blocked
trigger: All configured LLM provider backends return errors or become unreachable simultaneously
mitigation: Enable tier-escalation cascade routing; configure multi-provider fallback; monitor provider health registry daily

impact: Agent dispatch or gate step is killed before completion and the task is marked failed
trigger: agent_dispatch_secs (default 600s) or gate_test_secs (default 900s) exceeded without returning a result
mitigation: Tune TimeoutConfig under [timeouts] in roko.toml; set hard_run_secs cap; alert when scheduler_no_progress threshold is breached

impact: Tasks fail verification; replan is triggered and compute is wasted on retry cycles
trigger: cargo compile/test/clippy gate returns non-zero across all retries in the roko-gate 7-rung pipeline
mitigation: Scope changes to minimal diff; tune adaptive gate thresholds via .roko/learn/gate-thresholds.json; inspect rung failure details before triggering replan

impact: Concurrent writes corrupt the snapshot or signal log and leave the workspace in an inconsistent state
trigger: workspace_lock_secs (default 5s) exceeded or concurrent plan runners contend on .roko/state/ without the single-writer lock
mitigation: Enforce single-writer lock for all workspace-mutating commands; apply disk-aware worktree admission controls; run non-overlapping plan sets

impact: Interrupted plan cannot resume and all in-progress task state and progress is lost
trigger: Process killed during graph checkpoint write leaving .roko/state/graph/ snapshot corrupted or incomplete
mitigation: Use --resume-plan with task-fingerprint validation; maintain rotation-bounded append-only episode logs; verify state snapshot integrity before resuming
